exit_code_test_coverage.notes: 每个子命令的退出码作用域契约必须由单元测试覆盖（每个已声明退出码 + 0 成功路径）；退出码仅在子命令作用域内解释，严禁跨子命令对照。

fault_injection_tests.notes: 共 29 场景（17 单元 + 12 power-loss）。power-loss 场景注入方式 = 强制断电（VM poweroff / 拔盘后重启），**不得用 kill -9 代替**；单元场景由 tests/unit/d-stage-audit-fault-tests.py执行并回写 actual_final_state / passed。未经全部场景通过的snapshot 禁止在阶段二 release commit 中使用。

crash_after_backed_up_persist.expected_final_state: journal=backed_up → recovery commits new tarball + new sha256 → self-check → cleanup; final OUT_DIR = new pair
crash_after_backed_up_persist.injection: kill -9 after persist_journal(state=backed_up), before new tarball mv（等价态构造）

crash_after_staged_persist.expected_final_state: next run parses journal=staged → validates staging_dir constraints + staging fingerprint → completes backup → backed_up → commit new pair → verified → cleanup; final OUT_DIR = new pair
crash_after_staged_persist.injection: kill -9 after persist_journal(state=staged), before backup old tarball mv（等价态构造）

crash_between_backup_mvs.expected_final_state: journal=staged + facts (old tar in .txn, old sha in OUT_DIR) → recovery completes remaining backup mv (guarded idempotent); final OUT_DIR = new pair
crash_between_backup_mvs.injection: kill -9 after old tarball mv into .txn, before old sha256 mv（等价态构造）

crash_between_tarball_mv_and_journal.expected_final_state: journal=backed_up + facts (new tar in OUT_DIR) → recovery skips tarball commit, commits sha256 directly; final OUT_DIR = new pair
crash_between_tarball_mv_and_journal.injection: kill -9 after new tarball mv to OUT_DIR, before persist_journal(state=tarball_committed)（等价态构造）

immediate_rollback_sidecar_unknown.expected_final_state: shared classify_out_pair classifies sidecar unknown → exit 9; sidecar deleted ONLY when precisely identified as new; journal and files preserved
immediate_rollback_sidecar_unknown.injection: before in-process rollback, rewrite OUT_DIR .sha256 to a format-legal single line whose hash field != new_tar_sha256

journal_corrupt.expected_final_state: startup parse fails → exit 9 + clear error; dsh manual cleanup

journal_write_fail_at_staged.expected_final_state: persist fails → exit 5; old pair NEVER moved (ordering guarantee); no data loss

lock_contention.expected_final_state: B acquire_snapshot_lock fails → exit 6 + clear error; B exits BEFORE creating any temp file / .txn / staging modification; A completes normally
lock_contention.injection: process A holds .snapshot.lock; start process B concurrently

noop_duplicate_sidecar.expected_final_state: idempotent no-op reuses strict sidecar validation → exit 9; malformed/duplicate sidecar NEVER accepted by no-op
noop_duplicate_sidecar.injection: pre-place OUT_DIR pair whose tarball == new snapshot content, but .sha256 contains two duplicate format-legal lines

old_pair_incomplete.expected_final_state: 4a completeness fail-closed → exit 9; no journal written, no files moved

old_pair_inconsistent.expected_final_state: 4a self-consistency check fails → exit 9; corruption evidence not silently discarded
old_pair_inconsistent.injection: pre-place OUT_DIR old pair whose tarball and .sha256 contents mismatch each other

old_pair_restore_incomplete.expected_final_state: three-way facts consistency check fails → exit 9; never silently restored to half-pair
old_pair_restore_incomplete.injection: journal old_tar=present but old tarball absent in both .txn and OUT_DIR, then re-run

out_dir_readonly.expected_final_state: lock/txn open fails → exit 5; OUT_DIR = old pair untouched; re-run after fixing perms resumes

power_loss_after_backed_up_persist.expected_final_state: journal=backed_up + .txn/old.* durable → recovery commits new pair → cleanup; OUT_DIR = new pair
power_loss_after_backed_up_persist.injection: poweroff after durable journal=backed_up and old pair fsync

power_loss_after_backup_mv_before_persis.expected_final_state: journal=staged + old pair only in .txn → backup guard skips → persist(backed_up) → commit → verified; OUT_DIR = new pair
power_loss_after_backup_mv_before_persis.injection: poweroff after old pair backup mv and before journal=backed_up

power_loss_after_restore_mv_before_clean.expected_final_state: journal=rolling_back + OUT_DIR complete old pair → re-enter rollback: self-check PASS → rollback commit = atomic rename .txn→.txn.tombstone + fsync → exit 1; crash after rename → tombstone residue discarded at next startup
power_loss_after_restore_mv_before_clean.injection: poweroff after rollback restore and before tombstone cleanup

power_loss_after_staged_persist.expected_final_state: journal=staged + staging durable → recovery completes backup → commit → verified → cleanup; OUT_DIR = new pair
power_loss_after_staged_persist.injection: poweroff after durable journal=staged and staging fsync

power_loss_after_tarball_mv.expected_final_state: journal=backed_up + new tar durable in OUT_DIR → recovery skips tar commit, commits sha; OUT_DIR = new pair
power_loss_after_tarball_mv.injection: poweroff after new tarball mv and before sha commit

power_loss_after_verified_before_cleanup.expected_final_state: journal=verified + complete new pair → redo cleanup → exit 0
power_loss_after_verified_before_cleanup.injection: poweroff after durable journal=verified and before cleanup

power_loss_backup_mv_fsync_window.expected_final_state: journal=staged; three-way: consistent → auto-resume; double-existence → exit 9; both absent → exit 9 (fail-closed)
power_loss_backup_mv_fsync_window.injection: poweroff after backup mv and before either cross-directory fsync

power_loss_before_staged_persist.expected_final_state: journal absent → discard .txn residue → fresh path (or 4a idempotent no-op); old pair untouched

power_loss_rollback_mid_delete_window.expected_final_state: OUT_DIR pair = (absent,new) → whitelist allows → continue deleting new sidecar → restore old pair → exit 1 (NEVER exit 9)
power_loss_rollback_mid_delete_window.injection: poweroff while rolling_back deletes the new sidecar

power_loss_rollback_mid_restore_window.expected_final_state: OUT_DIR pair = (old,absent) DETERMINISTIC (per-mv barrier) → whitelist allows → complete sidecar restore → exit 1
power_loss_rollback_mid_restore_window.injection: poweroff after rollback restores old tar and before old sidecar

power_loss_rollback_restore_fsync_window.expected_final_state: per-restored-file four-way matrix: tar target-only (old,absent) / source-only (absent,absent); sidecar target-only (old,old) / source-only (old,absent) → whitelist re-enter; double-existence / both-absent → exit 9 (fail-closed)
power_loss_rollback_restore_fsync_window.injection: poweroff after one rollback restore mv and before its cross-directory fsync

power_loss_verified_cleanup_after_journa.expected_final_state: journal absent + .txn without old.* → fresh path → 4a idempotent no-op exit 0
power_loss_verified_cleanup_after_journa.injection: poweroff after journal removal and before .txn cleanup

selfcheck_fail.expected_final_state: 4e sha256sum -c FAIL → persist rolling_back → classify: tampered sidecar → unknown → exit 9 keeping journal and scene (fail-closed; pre-v17 'auto rollback to old pair' expectation retired)
selfcheck_fail.injection: write wrong sha256 content (same file size)

staging_dir_path_traversal.expected_final_state: path constraint validation fails → exit 9; no mv performed
staging_dir_path_traversal.injection: rewrite journal staging_dir to point outside .txn/staging

unknown_content_in_out_dir.expected_final_state: fingerprint classification = unknown → exit 9; unknown content never misjudged/deleted
unknown_content_in_out_dir.injection: replace OUT_DIR tarball with a third-party file

verified_half_pair.expected_final_state: state-specific invariant fails → exit 9; NO evidence cleanup
verified_half_pair.injection: manually craft journal=verified with OUT_DIR containing only the new tarball (no .sha256)

snapshot_boundary: 本快照 SHA 仅在 tar 1.35 + zstd 1.5.7 + jq ≥ 1.7.1 （dpkg 包版本口径，dsh 裁定 2026-09-08）+ 本机构建环境下可复现；其他版本/环境需重新生成 reference snapshot 并按 genesis.json tool_versions 比对。
